## Maintainer ruling recorded — Y, ruled together with #7204: one container-driven predicate closes this band

Director seat (objectstack #12708), summon #8, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-02.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-02, replying to decision batch #5 in which #7204 and this card were items 2 and 3, presented as one ruling with the recommendation Y. Verbatim reply: 「同意」.

**Ruled: Y** — the full ruling text is on #7204 (comment posted in the same stroke). For this card the operative part is option **B of this card's own list, folded into #7204's predicate**: the sublabel's gate moves off the viewport media query onto the same container width the Start/End column gate reads, and the sublabel renders exactly when the columns are not painted. Option C (accept the hover tooltip as the fallback) is not taken — hover-only, and `tooltipFields` defeats it.

Execution: one dispatch with #7204 in the `domain:ui` lane; this card's viewport table (500 / 639 / 640 / 800 / 1024 / 1440 / 1920, real browser) is the acceptance pin for this half.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` cleared; `pm:queue` stands as the single state (this card carried both labels at once since filing — the double state is repaired here). Ledger: objectstack director seat post #12708, summon #8.

Claim: `domain:ui` execution seat, PM session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`, R2. **Dispatched together with #7204 as one PR**, on branch `claude/issue-7204-gantt-tasklist-width` — per the maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-02 (verbatim 「同意」, option Y), which ruled both cards as one because they are the same file and the same two functions.

⛔ Do not claim this card separately; the full dispatch record is on **#7204** (comment above it in that thread).

**Why one PR is right rather than tidy**: this card and #7204 are two symptoms of a single root — the Start/End columns are gated by a **container** measurement (`showStartEndColumns`, a ResizeObserver width) while the date sublabel is gated by a **viewport** media query (`gantt-sm-hidden`, `@media (min-width: 640px)`), and neither predicate is the complement of the other. Fixing either alone leaves the split standing and lets them drift apart again. Ruled part 1 collapses them to **one container-driven predicate**, which closes this card's 640–1023 band at the root, and also the dragged-narrow case at any width.

This card supplies the **acceptance table** for that half: the sublabel must be visible exactly when the columns are not painted, pinned in a **real browser** at 500 / 639 / 640 / 800 / 1024 / 1440 / 1920. ⚠️ jsdom cannot decide it — it applies the media rule irrespective of `innerWidth` and returns `display: none` at every width, which is a false confirmation in the reassuring direction.
